editorial:
Imagine trying to go straight after a long stint in prison, only to have life throw a massive curveball your way. That is exactly what happens to René. He wants to be a better man, but when his son gets deathly sick, the cost of medical care pushes him back into the world of crime. You get to follow René and his crew as they attempt a high-stakes safe cracking job at a fancy villa. It feels like a classic heist flick where you really root for the underdog, even if he is breaking the law. The vibe is gritty but grounded, making you feel the pressure René is under to save his child.

What really works here is the tension. Just when you think the plan is going smoothly, you realize the crew is actually being used as a distraction for a much bigger crime. The acting is solid and the plot twists keep you guessing. While some parts of the pacing feel a bit slow, the payoff is worth it. If you enjoy old-school crime dramas, you should definitely grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to see the detail. Otherwise, renting it on Apple TV is a great way to experience this hidden gem without spending too much.
endingExplained: In the final act, the big twist is revealed: the criminals who hired René never intended for him to get the money. They used him as a decoy to keep the police busy while they stole something far more valuable. After a tense showdown, René manages to outsmart the real villains. He secures enough money to pay for his son's treatment and narrowly avoids going back to jail, finally finding a way to protect his family.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic heist movies and stories about fathers doing anything for their kids.
